description: Operational dashboard for Chronicle API traffic, combat-log parsing, River queues, caches, authentication, and leader election.

links.title: Chronicle Prometheus guide
links.tooltip: Dashboard and alert documentation in the Chronicle repository

panels.description: Minimum Prometheus target health across the selected Chronicle replicas. Alert if this remains 0 beyond the normal restart window.
panels.title: Scrape health

panels.description: Number of selected Chronicle targets currently scraped successfully.
panels.title: Healthy replicas

panels.description: Current request throughput across the selected Chronicle replicas.
panels.title: API requests / second

panels.description: Service-wide p95 API handler latency. Starting thresholds are 1 second warning and 2 seconds critical; tune them to your SLO.
panels.title: API p95 latency

panels.description: Retryable parser failures divided by all parser outcomes. Low-volume installations should alert on counts instead of ratios.
panels.title: Parse failure ratio

panels.description: Age of the oldest active parsing job. This is based on job creation time, not exact time in the current state.
panels.title: Oldest parsing backlog

panels.description: Completed API handler requests per second.
panels.title: Request rate by method

panels.description: Service-wide API handler latency percentiles.
panels.title: API latency percentiles

panels.description: Requests currently executing. Sustained growth with rising latency indicates saturation or a downstream bottleneck.
panels.title: Concurrent API requests

panels.description: Top route templates by p95 latency. Chronicle does not currently label requests with HTTP response status.

targets.expr: topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, path) (rate(chronicle_api_request_latencies_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Slowest route patterns by p95

panels.description: Parser outcomes per second. failure is retryable; cancelled usually represents a permanent or invalid-input outcome.
panels.title: Parse outcomes

panels.description: End-to-end log-parse worker duration.
panels.title: Total parse duration

panels.description: Combat-log line and encounter throughput.
panels.title: Parsing throughput

panels.description: Instances counted by completed parser jobs during the last hour.
panels.title: Parsed instances in the last hour

panels.description: Successfully persisted encounters during the last hour.
panels.title: Parsed encounters in the last hour

panels.description: Retryable parser failures. Investigate any sustained increase.
panels.title: Parser failures in the last hour

panels.description: Instance finalization or validation failures that did not immediately fail the entire parse job.
panels.title: Partial instance failures in the last hour

panels.description: Compare parser stages to identify object-storage, CPU, finalization, or PostgreSQL bottlenecks.
panels.title: Parser stage p95

panels.description: Code-defined parser and consumer stages ranked by p95 duration.
panels.title: Slowest parser consumers by p95

panels.description: Database-global active job counts. max removes duplicate samples emitted by multiple Chronicle replicas.
panels.title: Active jobs by queue and state

panels.description: Ready, pending, and retryable jobs. Scheduled jobs are excluded because they are often intentional.

targets.expr: sum by (queue) (max by (queue, state) (chronicle_river_queue_jobs{job=~"$job", queue=~"$queue", state=~"available|pending|retryable"}))

panels.title: Actionable backlog by queue

panels.description: Age from job creation time. It is not exact time spent in the current state.
panels.title: Oldest active job age

panels.description: Database-global running jobs divided by total worker capacity across all replicas. Alert only when saturation is sustained and backlog is growing.

targets.expr: max by (queue) (chronicle_river_queue_jobs{job=~"$job", queue=~"$queue", state="running"}) / clamp_min(sum by (queue) (chronicle_river_configured_workers{job=~"$job", queue=~"$queue"}), 1)

panels.title: Worker saturation

panels.description: Execution outcomes. retryable is a failed attempt; discarded is a permanent terminal outcome.
panels.title: River outcomes

panels.description: Time jobs waited before a worker began execution.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, queue, kind) (rate(chronicle_river_job_queue_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue=~"$queue"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Queue wait p95

panels.description: Time spent executing worker code.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, queue, kind) (rate(chronicle_river_job_run_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue=~"$queue"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Worker run p95

panels.description: Time River spent persisting the execution result. High values often indicate PostgreSQL pressure.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, queue, kind) (rate(chronicle_river_job_complete_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue=~"$queue"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Result persistence p95

panels.description: PostgreSQL query and lock latency while fetching jobs.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, queue) (rate(chronicle_river_job_fetch_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue=~"$queue"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: River fetch latency p95

panels.description: Jobs fetched and locked by workers.
panels.title: Jobs fetched / second

panels.description: Failures in the PostgreSQL-backed queue-state collector over the last 10 minutes. Queue panels can appear empty during a failure.
panels.title: Queue collector failures

panels.description: Hit ratio aggregated across the selected replicas. Treat this as a regression signal, not a universal paging alert.

targets.expr: sum by (cache) (rate(chronicle_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", cache=~"$cache"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (cache) (rate(chronicle_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", cache=~"$cache"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (cache) (rate(chronicle_cache_misses_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", cache=~"$cache"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.000001)

panels.title: Cache hit ratio

panels.description: Highest entries/capacity ratio among selected replicas. Reaching capacity is normal for an LRU cache; correlate with hit ratio and latency.

targets.expr: max by (cache) (chronicle_cache_entries{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", cache=~"$cache"} / chronicle_cache_capacity{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", cache=~"$cache"})

panels.title: Fullest replica cache utilization

panels.description: Cache hits and misses by cache.
panels.title: Cache operations / second

panels.description: Largest per-dataset cache populations. Dataset labels are UUIDs for game-data caches.

targets.expr: topk(20, max by (cache, dataset) (chronicle_cache_dataset_entries{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", cache=~"$cache", dataset=~"$dataset"}))

panels.title: Largest dataset cache populations

panels.description: Elapsed time since any selected replica completed an error-free billing reconciliation.
panels.title: Time since billing reconciliation success

panels.description: Subscription failures from the selected replica with the newest reconciliation completion.
panels.title: Latest subscription errors

panels.description: Entitlement customer failures from the selected replica with the newest reconciliation completion.
panels.title: Latest entitlement errors

panels.description: Failed Stripe entitlement synchronization attempts across selected replicas.
panels.title: Entitlement sync errors in 1 hour

panels.description: Completed and failed billing reconciliation runs across selected replicas.
panels.title: Billing reconciliation outcomes

panels.description: Customers synchronized divided by customers found in the newest reconciliation run. A failed customer retains its previous entitlement snapshot.

targets.expr: sum(chronicle_billing_reconciliation_entitlement_customers_synced{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) topk(1, chronicle_billing_reconciliation_last_completed_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) / clamp_min(sum(chronicle_billing_reconciliation_entitlement_customers_found{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) topk(1, chronicle_billing_reconciliation_last_completed_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})), 1)

panels.title: Latest entitlement customer coverage

panels.description: Expected to be exactly 1 for each enabled election. Optional services may expose no series.
panels.title: Leader count

panels.description: Election failures over a rolling 15-minute window.
panels.title: Leader-election failures

panels.description: Leadership acquisitions and losses over a rolling hour. Frequent changes indicate flapping.
panels.title: Leadership transitions

panels.description: Invalid validations divided by all validations over 15 minutes. These count-like metrics are implemented as gauges and reset on restart.
panels.title: Invalid session ratio

panels.description: Validation attempts over 15 minutes, with negative restart deltas clamped to zero.
panels.title: Session validations in 15 minutes

panels.description: Sessions created over one hour. The source metric is a gauge with count semantics and resets on restart.
panels.title: Sessions created in the last hour
